user.title: Sonara — Choose connection
user.description:
Sonara is a cast of cloud voices for Home Assistant: narration, characters, and sung lines.

**Community proxy** (recommended) — No account needed. Uses the open-source speech proxy by [Weilbyte](https://github.com/Weilbyte/tiktok-tts). Self-host that proxy if you want a more stable endpoint.

**Direct** — Calls the upstream speech servers yourself with a session cookie from a logged-in browser. This uses an unofficial API and may violate that service's terms. Use at your own risk.

---
*Voice engine originally wrapped by [@philipp-luettecke](https://github.com/philipp-luettecke/tiktoktts). Extended by [@sfox38](https://github.com/sfox38/tiktoktts). Repackaged as Sonara.*

proxy.title: Sonara — Proxy
proxy.description: Default endpoint is the community proxy hosted by [Weilbyte](https://github.com/Weilbyte/tiktok-tts). For reliability, self-host that proxy and paste its URL here.

direct.title: Sonara — Direct
direct.description:
Warning: this calls an unofficial internal speech API. Use may violate that service's terms.

To find your session ID:
1. Log in to the voice service in your browser
2. Open Developer Tools (F12) → Application → Cookies
3. Copy the value of the `sessionid` cookie

direct_api_session_expired.title: Sonara: direct session expired
direct_api_session_expired.description:
Your session ID is invalid or has expired. Sonara in direct mode will not speak until you update it.

To fix this:
1. Log in to the voice service in your browser
2. Open Developer Tools (F12) → Application → Cookies
3. Copy the value of the `sessionid` cookie
4. Go to **Settings → Devices & Services → Sonara → Configure** and paste the new session ID.
